title: Ravens land Cam Jurgens: the biggest trade since Roquan
subtitle: A Pro Bowl center from Philly, an unconventional Lamar sprain, and Sunday night at Atlanta.

scenes.label: The deal
scenes.heading: Ravens acquire C *Cam Jurgens* from the Eagles
scenes.caption: The Ravens acquire center Cam Jurgens from the Eagles. It's the biggest Ravens trade since Roquan Smith.

scenes.label: The haul
scenes.heading: What each side gave up
scenes.caption: Baltimore gives up a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick, and gets Jurgens plus a 2027 seventh. He's under contract through 2029 at about 17 million AAV.

Ravens get** Jurgens and a 2027 7th-round pick.

cards.label: protocol — expected debut next week vs Cleveland
Ioane to RG, Simpson at LG

scenes.caption: Jurgens is 27 and a two-time Pro Bowler, but he's in concussion protocol. Per Schefter, he's expected to debut next week versus Cleveland, not at Atlanta. The plan moves Ioane back to right guard and Simpson to left guard.

scenes.heading: An "unconventional" ankle sprain

data.text: "There is a lot of time between now and Sunday… When he is ready to play, he will be ready to play."

scenes.caption: Lamar did not practice Wednesday. Rapoport calls the sprain unconventional: neither a low nor a high ankle sprain. He still has an outside chance for Sunday and could miss multiple games.
